DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日はどのようなことをお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日、自転車がなくなったと相談しました。今日、管理者から見つかったと連絡があったので、昨日の相談に追加で知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前日に自転車の不在を相談したが管理者から発見の連絡が来たので、既存の相談に情報を追加したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came to you yesterday because my bicycle was missing. Today, the manager told me it had been found, so I'd like to add that information to yesterday's inquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you reported your bicycle missing yesterday and want to add information to the existing inquiry because the manager has contacted you to say it was found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 昨日の相談の控えはありますか。見つけたという連絡は、どなたが、どこにあると伝えてきましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the reference slip from yesterday's inquiry? Who told you it was found, and where did they say it was?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 控えはこちらです。スーパーの管理者から、入口を片付けた時に自転車を保管室へ移したと聞きました。私はまだ受け取っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日の相談控えを示し、スーパーの管理者が片付け時に保管室へ移したと連絡したが、現物はまだ受け取っていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's the slip. The supermarket manager said they moved a bicycle into the storage room when clearing the entrance. I haven't collected it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show yesterday's reference slip and explain that the supermarket manager said a bicycle was moved into storage during clearing, but you have not collected it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 移したという連絡と、ご自身の自転車だと確認できたことを分けて伺います。車体の特徴や番号は確認できましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll distinguish being told it was moved from confirming that it is your bicycle. Have you checked its features or number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 送られた写真は銀色で、後ろに黒いかごがあります。私の物に似ていますが、番号はぼやけて読めません。登録の控えと比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真は銀色で後ろに黒いかごがあるが番号は読めないので、似た外見だけで自分の自転車と決めず登録控えと比べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The photo they sent shows a silver bicycle with a black basket at the back. It looks like mine, but the number is too blurry to read. I'd like to compare it with my registration slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the photo shows a silver bicycle with a black rear basket but an unreadable number, so you want to compare it with your registration rather than assume it is yours from appearance alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今は特徴が似た候補として伝えてください。管理者に番号を確認し、控えと照合できます。保管室へ勝手に入らず、受取りの方法も管理者へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: For now, please describe it as a possible match with similar features. You can ask the manager to check the number and compare it with your slip. Don't enter the storage room without permission; check with the manager how to collect it as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 管理者から番号を送ってもらい、控えと一致しました。受取りは明日です。今日の時点では、所在を確認できたけれど手元には戻っていないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 管理者から届いた車体番号が控えと一致したと報告し、受取りは明日なので所在確認と手元への返却を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The manager sent me the number, and it matches my slip. I'll collect it tomorrow. As of today, I'll say I've confirmed where it is but haven't got it back yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that the bicycle number sent by the manager matches your slip, and distinguish confirming its location from getting it back because collection is tomorrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。その二つを分けて記録を確認します。昨日の相談を担当した方にも、連絡元と確認できた番号、受取予定をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We'll check the record with those two things kept separate. Please also tell the person who handled yesterday's inquiry who contacted you, the confirmed number, and your planned collection.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えを示し、管理者の保管室で番号が一致したことと、明日受け取る予定を知らせます。受取り後の連絡が必要かも担当者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 昨日の控えを示して保管場所、番号の一致、翌日の受取予定を担当者へ知らせ、受取後に追加連絡が必要か確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the reference slip and tell them that the number of the bicycle in the manager's storage room matches and that I plan to collect it tomorrow. I'll also ask whether I need to contact them after collecting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show yesterday's slip and tell the person in charge the storage location, matching number, and planned collection tomorrow, and ask whether further contact is needed after collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。昨日の相談記録を確認し、担当へ追加の情報を伝えます。受取りが済んだことと取り違えずにご説明いただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll check yesterday's inquiry record and pass the additional information to the person in charge. Thank you for explaining it without confusing this with having already collected it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便物について、何を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about your mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 不在票を持ってきました。この荷物を今、私が受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在票を示し、自分が今この荷物を窓口で受け取れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've brought a missed-delivery notice. Can I collect this parcel at the counter now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the missed-delivery notice and ask whether you can collect this parcel yourself at the counter now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 不在票の宛名と、保管についての表示を確認させてください。宛名の方はご本人ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please let me check the addressee and storage information on the notice. Are you the named recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住所だけ見て自分宛てだと思いましたが、夫の名前でした。同じ住所に住んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所だけで自分宛てだと思ったが宛名は夫だったと説明し、同居していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I assumed it was for me from the address alone, but it's in my husband's name. We live at the same address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you assumed it was yours from the address but the addressee is your husband, and say you live together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 郵便物の種類によって受け取りの確認事項が違います。ご主人は、今日、荷物の受け取りができますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The checks needed for collection depend on the type of mail. Is your husband able to receive the parcel today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夜なら家にいます。私が窓口で受け取るのに必要なものが足りなければ、夫宛ての再配達にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 夫は夜なら在宅できると伝え、自分の窓口受取に必要なものが足りなければ夫宛ての再配達を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: He'll be home in the evening. If I don't have what I need to collect it at the counter, I'd like it redelivered to my husband.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your husband can be home in the evening and request redelivery to him if you lack what is needed to collect it yourself at the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず、この郵便物を窓口で渡せる条件と保管状況を確認します。再配達なら、不在票の案内から手続きできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: First, we'll check the conditions for handing this item over at the counter and its storage status. For redelivery, you can follow the instructions on the missed-delivery notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 再配達の入力で私の名前を入れてしまいそうでした。宛名は夫のままにして、連絡先を入力する欄とは分けるんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 再配達で自分の名を入力しそうだったと伝え、荷物の宛名と連絡先の欄を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I nearly entered my own name in the redelivery form. The addressee should stay as my husband, separate from the contact-details field, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you almost entered your own name for redelivery and check the addressee and contact-details fields separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、各欄の説明に沿って入力してください。保管期限と、申し込める配達日時も画面で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please follow the instructions for each field. You can also check the storage deadline and available delivery dates and times on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 宛名、保管期限、選べる時間を確かめます。夫に在宅時間を聞いてから、不在票の案内で再配達を申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名と保管期限、選べる時間を確かめ、夫の在宅時間を聞いてから不在票の案内で再配達を申し込むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the addressee, storage deadline, and available times. After asking my husband when he'll be home, I'll request redelivery using the notice's instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the addressee, storage deadline, and available times, ask your husband when he will be home, and request redelivery using the notice's instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。宛名と連絡先を取り違えないようご確認ください。手続きで迷ったらまたお尋ねください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please be careful not to confuse the addressee with the contact details. Ask again if you're unsure about the procedure. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。銀行でどのようなお手続きが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What banking procedure do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 釧路で働き始めるので、給与を受け取る口座を作りたいです。会社の紙に書かれた支店と同じ所でないとだめですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与口座を作りたいので、会社の紙に書かれた支店で申し込む必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm starting work in Kushiro and would like to open an account to receive my salary. Does it have to be at the same branch shown on the company's paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you need to apply at the branch shown on the company's paper to open a salary account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務先がどの金融機関や支店を指定しているか、案内を確認しましょう。書類を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the instructions to see which financial institution or branch your employer specifies. May I see the document?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この紙です。支店名は記入例のようです。「振込可能な口座」とだけ書いてあるので、会社へ確認してから申し込みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 支店名は記入例らしく、振込可能な口座とだけ書かれているため、会社に確認してから申し込みたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. The branch name seems to be an example entry. It only says 'an account that can receive transfers,' so I'd like to check with the company before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the branch name appears to be an example and the paper only specifies an account that can receive transfers, so you want to check with the company before applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 勤務先の条件を確認したうえで、当行での申込条件をご案内します。今のお住まいを確認できる書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Once you've confirmed your employer's requirements, we'll explain our bank's application conditions. Do you have documents that verify your current address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 在留カードの住所は変更しました。でも携帯料金の明細は前の住所です。古い明細も一緒に出すと、かえって紛らわしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 在留カードは新住所に変更済みだが携帯料金の明細は旧住所で、両方出すと紛らわしいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've changed the address on my residence card. But my mobile phone statement has my old address. Would submitting the old statement too make things more confusing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your residence card has the new address but your phone statement has the old one, and ask whether submitting both would be confusing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類の種類と現在の記載内容を確認します。古い住所の書類については、その事情をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the types of documents and what they currently say. Please explain the circumstances of the document with the old address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しい住所のカードと、会社からの雇用の案内を持っています。今日持っている書類で足りるか、一覧にして教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新住所のカードと雇用の案内を持っているので、必要書類と不足するものを一覧にしてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the card showing my new address and the employment information from my company. Please give me a list showing whether the documents I brought today are enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have a card showing your new address and employment information, and ask for a list of required and missing documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 拝見して、必要な書類と不足しているものを整理します。受付しただけでは口座開設が確定しない点もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll look at them and organize which documents are needed and which are missing. Please also note that accepting an application does not confirm that an account will be opened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社の振込条件を先に聞きます。新住所の書類を中心に、必要な追加書類を揃えてから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社の振込条件を先に確認し、新住所の書類を中心に追加書類をそろえてから申し込むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll first ask about the company's transfer requirements. I'll focus on documents showing my new address and apply after gathering any additional documents needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will first check the company's transfer requirements and gather additional documents, using new-address documents as the basis, before applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。では、お持ちの書類を確認しましょう。申込条件で不明な点は遠慮なくお尋ねください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Noted. Let's check the documents you've brought. Please don't hesitate to ask about anything unclear in the application conditions. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。商品選びで何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Can I help you choose a product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 魚を使わないスープを作りたいです。この野菜だしは、名前が野菜なら魚も入っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 魚を使わないスープを作りたいと伝え、野菜だしという名前なら魚は入っていないのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to make a soup without fish. If this is called vegetable stock, does that mean it contains no fish?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to make soup without fish and ask whether the name vegetable stock means it contains no fish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品名だけでは判断できません。裏の原材料表示を一緒に見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can't judge from the product name alone. Let's look at the ingredient list on the back together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここに「かつおエキス」とありますね。野菜だけだと思っていました。魚の原料がないものを探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 原材料にかつおエキスがあると確認し、野菜だけだと思っていたので魚の原料がない別の商品を探したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says 'bonito extract' here. I thought it contained only vegetables. I'd like to find something without fish ingredients.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the ingredients include bonito extract and say you want another product without fish ingredients, as you thought this one was vegetables only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の商品と比較できます。食事の制限として、ほかに避けたい原材料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can compare it with another product. Are there any other ingredients you want to avoid as part of your dietary restrictions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 魚以外は今のところありません。ただ、この小さい字を読むのに時間がかかります。候補を二つ並べて見てもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今避けたい原材料は魚だけだと答え、小さい表示を読むため二つの候補を並べてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Nothing besides fish for now. But it takes me time to read this small print. May I put two options side by side to look at them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say fish is the only ingredient you currently want to avoid and ask to place two options side by side to read the small labels. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。表示が読みづらい部分は、メーカーへの確認先もお調べできます。表示からわからない点を推測でお答えすることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. For parts of the label that are hard to read, we can also look up how to contact the manufacturer. We can't answer by guessing about anything the label doesn't clarify.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらは原材料が野菜と塩ですが、「同じ工場」の注意書きがあります。これは原材料欄とは別の情報なんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 野菜と塩の原材料欄とは別に同じ工場の注意書きがあると示し、情報の違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: This one lists vegetables and salt as ingredients, but it has a 'same factory' warning. That's separate information from the ingredient list, isn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Point out the same-factory warning separate from the vegetables-and-salt ingredient list, and check the difference between those types of information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、原材料と製造時の注意事項は分けて確認してください。どこまで避ける必要があるかによって、確認する内容も変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please check ingredients and manufacturing warnings separately. What needs checking also depends on how strictly you need to avoid an ingredient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 商品名で決めず、原材料と注意書きを両方読みます。今回は家族にも確認してから選ぶので、この二つの写真を撮ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品名だけで決めず原材料と注意書きを読み、家族へ確認するため写真を撮ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't choose based on the product name. I'll read both the ingredients and warnings. This time, I'll also check with my family before choosing. May I photograph these two products?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will read the ingredients and warnings rather than decide from the product name alone, and ask to take photos to check with your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 撮影については売場の案内に従ってください。迷う点はメーカーに確認してからお選びいただけます。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow the section's guidance on photography. You can check any uncertainties with the manufacturer before choosing. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。園内のご案内で、何を知りたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to know about the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し散歩したいのですが、霧で先が見えません。この地図の線を一周すれば、案内所へ戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 霧の中で短い散歩をしたいと伝え、地図の道を一周すれば案内所へ戻れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like a short walk, but I can't see ahead because of the fog. If I follow this line on the map all the way around, will I get back to the information center?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want a short walk in the fog and ask whether following the mapped path around will bring you back to the information center. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在地と線のつながりを見ましょう。こちらは周回ではなく、同じ道を戻る区間です。どのくらい歩くご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's look at where you are and how the lines connect. This isn't a loop; it's a stretch where you return along the same path. How long are you planning to walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二十分ほどです。一周だと思っていたので、戻る時間を考えていませんでした。途中で引き返せる道にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二十分ほど歩きたいが往復の帰り時間を考えていなかったと説明し、途中で引き返せる道を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: About twenty minutes. I thought it was a loop, so I hadn't allowed for the time needed to return. I'd like a route where I can turn back partway.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to walk for about twenty minutes but had not allowed for the return time, and request a path where you can turn back partway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日の通路の状況も確認しましょう。案内表示が見える範囲で歩き、霧が濃い所へ無理に進まないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's also check today's path conditions. Stay within the area where you can see the signs, and don't force yourself onward into thick fog.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 遠くの展望場所へ行きたかったのですが、今はやめます。案内所から見える道の分かれ目だけ、地図で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 遠い展望場所へは行かないと伝え、案内所から見える分かれ目を地図で教えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I wanted to go to the distant viewpoint, but I won't do that now. Please just show me on the map the fork visible from the information center.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not go to the distant viewpoint and ask to be shown the fork visible from the information center on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 地図ではこの分かれ目です。現地の表示と違って見えたら、進まず引き返してください。戻り先はこの現在地です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's this fork on the map. If the signs on site look different, don't continue; turn back. This current-location marker is where you should return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰りに違う道へ曲がらないよう、最初の分かれ目を覚えます。携帯の地図が使えなくても戻れる範囲にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最初の分かれ目を覚え、携帯の地図が使えなくても戻れる範囲にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll remember the first fork so I don't turn onto a different path on the way back. I'll stay within a range where I can return even if I can't use my phone's map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will remember the first fork and stay within a range where you can return without your phone's map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その判断でよいでしょう。園内の最新の注意表示を見てから出発してください。状況が悪くなったら散歩を切り上げてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That sounds sensible. Check the latest warning signs in the park before setting out. If conditions worsen, cut your walk short.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 展望場所には向かわず、表示が見える範囲を往復します。十分ほどで引き返して、同じ案内所へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 展望場所へ進まず表示が見える範囲を往復し、十分ほどで引き返して案内所へ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't head to the viewpoint. I'll walk out and back where I can see the signs. I'll turn around after about ten minutes and return to this same information center.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will avoid the viewpoint, walk out and back within sight of the signs, turn around after about ten minutes, and return to the information center. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。見通しが悪い時は短く切り上げてください。お気をつけて、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. If visibility is poor, cut the walk short. Take care and enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。列車のご案内で、何をお調べしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What train information would you like me to look up?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日の帰りの最終列車を知りたいです。携帯に出ているこの時刻までに北見駅へ戻れば大丈夫でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今日の帰りの最終列車を知りたいと伝え、携帯の時刻までに駅へ戻ればよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to know today's last train home. Will I be okay if I get back to Kitami Station by this time shown on my phone?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to know today's last train home and ask whether getting back to the station by the time on your phone is enough. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 目的地と、画面で選ばれている出発駅を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you tell me your destination and the departure station selected on the screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 目的地はこちらです。でも画面は目的地から北見へ来る方向でした。帰る方向に直して調べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目的地を示し、検索が目的地から北見へ来る逆方向だったので帰りの方向に直したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is my destination. But the screen is showing the direction from there to Kitami. I'd like to correct it to the direction for going home and search again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your destination and explain that the search was in the reverse direction, toward Kitami, and you want to change it to your homeward direction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 方向を直しましょう。検索日は今日になっていますか。曜日も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's correct the direction. Is the search date set to today? Please check the day of the week, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日付が先週のままでした。今日は仕事が長引くかもしれないので、最終だけでなく一つ前の候補も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 検索日が先週のままだったと伝え、仕事が長引く可能性があるので最終と一つ前の候補を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The date was still set to last week. Work may run late today, so I'd like to check not only the last train but the one before it, too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the search date was still last week's and you want to check the last train and the one before it because work may run late. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 当日の帰る方向に直した画面では、一つ前が20時10分、最終が21時05分で、どちらも乗換なしです。仕事先から駅まで、何分かかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: With the screen corrected to today's homeward direction, the train before the last is at 20:10 and the last is at 21:05. Neither requires a transfer. How long does it take from your workplace to the station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 徒歩20分で、退勤予定は19時40分です。予定どおりなら駅へ20時で、一つ前まで10分あります。長引けば無理に走らず、会社の送迎も相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 徒歩20分と退勤19時40分なら駅へ20時で一つ前まで10分あると計算し、長引けば走らず会社の送迎も相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's a twenty-minute walk, and I'm scheduled to finish at 19:40. If things go as planned, I'll reach the station at 20:00, ten minutes before the earlier train. If work runs late, I won't rush and run; I'll also ask the company about a lift.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Calculate that finishing at 19:40 and walking twenty minutes gets you to the station at 20:00, ten minutes before the earlier train, and say you will ask about a company lift rather than run if delayed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 19時40分に出て20分歩くと20時、20時10分まで10分ですね。今示した二つは候補で、当日の変更は出発前の運行案内で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Leaving at 19:40 and walking twenty minutes gets you there at 20:00, ten minutes before 20:10, yes. These two services are options; please check the current service information before leaving for any changes that day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一つ前20時10分と最終21時05分、どちらも乗換なしと控えました。予定どおりなら一つ前を候補にして、退勤が遅れそうなら出る前に送迎も相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一つ前20時10分と最終21時05分は乗換なしと控え、予定どおりなら一つ前、退勤が遅れそうなら先に送迎を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've noted the earlier train at 20:10 and the last at 21:05, both direct. If things go as planned, I'll consider the earlier one. If it looks as though work will finish late, I'll ask about a lift before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have noted the direct trains at 20:10 and 21:05, will consider the earlier one if on schedule, and will ask about a lift first if work looks likely to finish late. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。出発前にも当日の案内をご確認ください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check today's information again before departure. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのような窓口をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Which counter are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社を辞めた後の健康保険について相談したいです。国民健康保険の窓口で番号札を取ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 退職後の健康保険を相談したいと伝え、国民健康保険の窓口で受付すればよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to discuss health insurance after leaving my job. Should I take a queue ticket at the National Health Insurance counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to discuss health insurance after leaving a job and ask whether to register at the National Health Insurance counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当窓口をご案内します。退職した日と、次の勤務先での保険の状況はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll show you to the appropriate counter. Do you know your leaving date and the insurance situation at your next employer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先月末に辞めました。新しい会社で働き始めていますが、保険の手続きが済んだかは聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先月末に退職し新しい会社で働き始めたが、新しい保険の手続き状況は未確認だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I left at the end of last month. I've started working for a new company, but I haven't asked whether the insurance procedure is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you left at the end of last month and have started at a new company but have not checked the new insurance procedure's status. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 加入の状況を確認する必要があります。前の会社から保険の資格についての書類は届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll need to check your enrollment status. Have you received documents about your insurance eligibility from your previous company?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 資格を失った日が書かれた書類はあります。新しい会社の開始日と同じだと思い込まず、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 前の保険の資格を失った日が分かる書類はあると伝え、新しい保険の開始日を思い込まず確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a document showing the date my eligibility ended. I'd like to check without assuming that's the same as the start date at my new company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have a document showing when your previous insurance eligibility ended and want to check the new insurance start date rather than assume it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その書類と、新しい会社に確認する事項を担当へお伝えください。今日は相談の受付を希望されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show that document to the person in charge and explain what you need to check with your new company. Would you like to register for a consultation today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、まず相談したいです。手続きに来たと言うと、今日加入するつもりだと思われそうなので、状況確認が先だと伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日は加入を決める前の状況相談を希望しており、その目的を担当にも伝えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I'd like to consult first. If I say I'm here for the procedure, they might think I intend to enroll today, so I'd like to explain that checking my situation comes first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want advice on your situation before deciding to enroll today and ask for that purpose to be passed to the person in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当には、退職後の保険の状況を整理したい相談としておつなぎします。時系列をメモしておくと説明しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll refer you for a consultation to clarify your insurance situation after leaving work. Writing down the timeline will make it easier to explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 退職日、資格を失った日、新しい会社の入社日を分けて書きます。新しい保険の開始日は未確認と明記します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 退職日、資格を失った日、入社日を分けて記し、新しい保険の開始日は未確認と明記すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write my leaving date, the date my eligibility ended, and the date I joined the new company separately. I'll clearly state that the new insurance start date is unconfirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will record the leaving date, eligibility end date, and new joining date separately and clearly mark the new insurance start date as unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当窓口でそのメモと書類をお見せください。案内した受付方法でお待ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please show that note and the documents at the appropriate counter. Wait according to the registration instructions I've given you. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お帰りの前に、何かご不明な点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything you're unsure about before you leave?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 薬を受け取りたいのですが、会計が終わったので、この紙を持ってここで待てばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計後に薬を受け取りたいと伝え、持っている紙を出して病院で待てばよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to collect my medicine. Since I've finished paying, should I wait here with this paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to collect your medicine after paying, show the paper you have, and ask whether to wait at the hospital. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちの紙を確認しましょう。それは領収書です。処方箋は別に渡されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the paper you have. That's a receipt. Were you given a separate prescription?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋にもう一枚ありました。「処方箋」と書いてあります。領収書だけ出して、薬を待つつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋に処方箋が別にあったと伝え、領収書だけを出して薬を待とうとしていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: There was another sheet in the bag. It says 'prescription.' I was going to show just the receipt and wait for the medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say there was a separate prescription in the bag and explain that you were going to show only the receipt and wait for the medicine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 処方箋の案内と、受け取り先を確認しましょう。院外の薬局で受け取る説明は聞かれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the prescription instructions and where to collect the medicine. Did you hear the explanation about collecting it at a pharmacy outside the hospital?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 聞き取れませんでした。指定の一軒にしか出せないと思っていたので、利用できる薬局の探し方も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 院外薬局の説明を聞き取れず指定の一軒だけだと思っていたと伝え、利用できる薬局の探し方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I didn't catch it. I thought I could only take it to one designated pharmacy, so I'd also like to ask how to find pharmacies I can use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you did not catch the explanation about outside pharmacies and thought only one designated pharmacy was allowed, and ask how to find one you can use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 処方箋を受け付ける薬局を確認してからお持ちください。薬の用意や対応は薬局へ確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check that a pharmacy accepts prescriptions before taking it there. You'll need to ask the pharmacy about preparing the medicine and what they can provide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仕事の後に寄るかもしれません。この紙の期限の部分を確認して、行く前に薬局へ電話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕事後に行く可能性があると伝え、処方箋の期限と薬局の受付を事前に確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I may stop by after work. I'd like to check the expiry section on this paper and call the pharmacy before going.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you may go after work and want to check the prescription's validity and the pharmacy's acceptance in advance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 期限の記載はこちらです。不明なら担当へ確認します。飲み方の質問は、処方した医療者や薬局の薬剤師へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The validity period is written here. If it's unclear, we'll check with the person in charge. Please ask the prescribing medical professional or the pharmacy's pharmacist about how to take the medicine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 処方箋と領収書を分けて保管します。期限と薬局の受付を確認して持参し、飲み方は薬剤師に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 処方箋と領収書を分け、期限と薬局の受付を確認して持参し、飲み方は薬剤師へ尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep the prescription and receipt separately. I'll check the validity and whether the pharmacy can accept it before taking it there, and ask the pharmacist how to take the medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separate the prescription and receipt, check validity and pharmacy acceptance before bringing it, and ask the pharmacist how to take the medicine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。処方箋をなくさずお持ちください。必要なら受付で確認先をご案内します。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please bring the prescription and keep it safe. Reception can direct you to whom to ask if needed. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。拾得物の記録について、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with the found-property record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今朝届けた鍵の控えを見たら、拾った時刻を「昼ごろ」と伝えていました。写真を見直したので、時刻だけ訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今朝届けた鍵の控えにある昼ごろという拾得時刻を、写真を見直したため訂正したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Looking at the slip for the keys I handed in this morning, I see I said I found them 'around noon.' I've looked back at a photo, so I'd like to correct just the time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to correct the time of finding the keys handed in this morning, recorded as around noon, after reviewing a photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 控えの番号を見せてください。どの写真から時刻を確認されたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the reference number. Which photo did you use to check the time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号はK-27です。友人に写真を送ったのが12時05分だったので、その時刻を拾った時だと思って話しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控え番号K-27を示し、友人へ写真を転送した12時05分を拾った時刻と勘違いして伝えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The number is K-27. I sent the photo to a friend at 12:05, so I thought that was the time I found them and told you that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give reference number K-27 and explain that you mistakenly reported 12:05, when you forwarded the photo to a friend, as the time you found the keys. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 12時05分は転送した時刻ですね。ご自身が撮った元の写真は残っていますか。撮る前後の出来事も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So 12:05 is when you forwarded it. Do you still have the original photo you took? Please also describe what happened before and after taking it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 元の写真は9時20分です。ベンチの下で見つけて、すぐその場で撮りました。ただ、拾った瞬間の分まで測ったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元の写真は9時20分で発見後すぐ撮ったが、拾った瞬間の正確な分は測っていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The original photo is from 9:20. I found them under a bench and immediately took the photo there. But I didn't measure the exact minute I picked them up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the original photo was at 9:20 and taken immediately after finding the keys, but you did not measure the exact minute of picking them up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 原写真の9時20分と、発見後すぐ撮ったという説明を記録します。拾得時刻は「9時20分ごろ」に直し、12時05分は転送時刻として分けます。場所も変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record 9:20 from the original photo and your explanation that you took it immediately after finding them. I'll change the time found to 'around 9:20' and record 12:05 separately as the forwarding time. Does the location change, too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 場所は同じバス停のベンチの下で、変わりません。鍵の写真を新しく撮り直したわけではなく、朝の原写真を見直しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 場所は同じバス停のベンチの下で、写真を撮り直したのではなく朝の原写真を見直したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, the location is still under the bench at the same bus stop. I didn't take a new photo of the keys; I reviewed the original photo from this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the location is still under the bench at the same bus stop and you reviewed the morning's original photo rather than taking a new one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: K-27の時刻は9時20分ごろへ訂正、場所はバス停のベンチの下のままです。昼の転送時刻を発見時刻から外した内容で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: For K-27, the time is corrected to around 9:20, and the location remains under the bench at the bus stop. Is it correct that we've removed the noon forwarding time from the time of discovery?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、合っています。控えK-27は9時20分ごろで、場所は同じです。12時05分は友人へ送った時刻で、拾った瞬間の正確な分は未確認です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: K-27の訂正後は9時20分ごろ、場所は変わらず、12時05分は転送時刻で拾得の正確な分は未確認だと読み返しを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, that's correct. For K-27, it's around 9:20, and the location is unchanged. 12:05 was when I sent it to my friend; the exact minute I picked up the keys is unconfirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the readback: K-27 is corrected to around 9:20, the location is unchanged, 12:05 is the forwarding time, and the exact minute of finding the keys is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 訂正内容を控えに記入しました。お手元でも時刻と場所をご確認ください。元の写真による追加説明をいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've entered the correction on the slip. Please check the time and location on your copy, too. Thank you for the additional explanation based on the original photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのような郵便のお手続きでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What postal procedure would you like help with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越したので、前の家に届く郵便を転送したいです。新しい勤務先の住所をここに書いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 引越し後の郵便転送を相談し、新しい勤務先の住所を書いてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've moved and want mail sent to my old home forwarded. Can I write my new workplace's address here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about forwarding mail after moving and whether you can enter your new workplace's address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 転送先として希望する住所を確認しましょう。勤務先で受け取るのか、今のお住まいで受け取るのか、どちらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the address you want mail forwarded to. Do you want to receive it at work or at your current home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家で受け取りたいです。会社の書類に書いた住所をそのまま使いそうでした。今住んでいる北見の部屋の住所にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取先は自宅だと説明し、会社向けの住所を流用せず今住む部屋の住所を記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want it at home. I nearly reused the address I wrote on the company paperwork. I'll put the address of the room where I'm now living in Kitami.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want delivery at home and will enter your current room's address rather than reuse an address intended for the company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 建物名と部屋番号までご記入ください。転居するのはご本人だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please include the building name and room number. Are you the only person moving?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 妻も一緒ですが、名字が違います。私の名前だけ書けば、妻宛ての郵便も転送されると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 妻も一緒に転居するが名字が違うと説明し、自分だけ記入すれば妻宛ても転送されると思っていたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: My wife is moving with me, but we have different surnames. I thought writing just my name would forward mail addressed to her, too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your wife is also moving but has a different surname, and that you thought entering only your name would forward her mail as well. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対象になる方の記入について、届出の案内を確認しましょう。名字が違う方も、必要な欄を省略しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the notification instructions on entering the people covered. Please don't omit required fields for someone with a different surname, either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人の名前を分けて書きます。引っ越した日は昨日ですが、転送の開始を希望する日とは別の欄ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二人の氏名を分けて書くと伝え、昨日の転居日と転送開始の希望日は別に記入するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll enter our two names separately. We moved yesterday. Is that a separate field from the date we'd like forwarding to begin?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will enter both names separately and ask whether yesterday's moving date and the requested forwarding start date go in separate fields. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それぞれの欄の説明に従ってご記入ください。受付から反映までの扱いも確認してお伝えします。即日開始と決めつけないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please follow the instructions for each field. We'll also check and explain how long it takes to take effect after submission. Don't assume it starts the same day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 部屋番号と二人の氏名を記入します。昨日の転居日と希望日を区別し、いつから反映されるかを案内で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部屋番号と二人の氏名を記入し、転居日と希望日を区別して反映の時期も確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll enter the room number and both our names. I'll distinguish yesterday's moving date from the requested date and check the instructions for when it will take effect.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will enter the room number and both names, distinguish the moving date from the requested date, and check when forwarding takes effect. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。記入内容と本人確認の方法を一緒に確認しましょう。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Let's check the entries and how to verify your identity together. Thank you for your inquiry.
